documents.title: October Complete Blood Count & Renal Panel
documents.heading: COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT
documents.content: Complete Blood Count & Renal Function Panel. Hemoglobin: 11.4 g/dL (Ref 12.0 - 16.0) [LOW]. WBC Count: 7.4 10^3/uL. Platelets: 245 10^3/uL. Serum Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL (Ref 0.6 - 1.2) normal kidney function.

documents.title: November Metabolic & Lipid Profile
documents.heading: METABOLIC & LIPID PROFILE
documents.content: Fasting Blood Glucose: 118 mg/dL (Ref 70 - 100) [HIGH]. HbA1c: 6.8 % (Ref 4.0 - 5.6) [HIGH]. Total Cholesterol: 228 mg/dL. LDL Cholesterol: 148 mg/dL. HDL Cholesterol: 46 mg/dL. Triglycerides: 162 mg/dL.

documents.title: September Thyroid & Liver Function Panel
documents.heading: THYROID & HEPATIC PANEL
documents.content: TSH: 4.8 mIU/L (Ref 0.4 - 4.0) [HIGH]. ALT (SGPT): 32 U/L (Ref 7 - 56). AST (SGOT): 28 U/L (Ref 10 - 40). Total Bilirubin: 0.8 mg/dL (Ref 0.1 - 1.2).

documents.title: Outpatient Clinic Prescription
documents.heading: PRESCRIPTION
documents.content: Rx. Tab. Metformin 500 mg oral twice daily after food for 30 days. Tab. Atorvastatin 10 mg once daily at bedtime for lipid control. Cap. Omeprazole 20 mg once daily before breakfast for acid reflux.

documents.title: Hospital Discharge Summary - Pneumonia
documents.heading: HOSPITAL COURSE & DISCHARGE
documents.content: Final Diagnosis: Community-acquired pneumonia, resolved. Admitted with fever and cough; responded well to inpatient antibiotics. Condition at Discharge: Stable, afebrile. Blood Pressure: 122/78 mmHg. Follow-up Plan: Outpatient pulmonary review after 7 days.

documents.title: Chest X-Ray PA View Radiology Report
documents.heading: RADIOLOGY IMPRESSION
documents.content: Chest X-Ray PA View. Technique: Posteroanterior chest radiograph. Findings: Lung fields are clear. Costophrenic angles are sharp. Cardiothoracic ratio is normal. Impression: No acute cardiopulmonary abnormality.
